entities.summary: Pedro Carmona-Alvarez (b. 1972-02-15, La Serena) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in La Serena and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
